name: Stability AI
summary: Stability AI is a generative AI company based in London. It is best known for the [Stable Diffusion](https://www.cnn.com/2023/12/21/tech/child-sexual-abuse-material-ai-training-data) image models.

incidents.title: Stanford Finds Child Sexual Abuse Material in LAION-5B, Used to Train Stability AI's Stable Diffusion
incidents.summary: The Stanford Internet Observatory found more than 1,000 verified child sexual abuse images in LAION-5B, a dataset used to train Stable Diffusion models. It said Stable Diffusion 1.5 remained the most popular model for explicit imagery and recommended that models based on it be withdrawn where feasible.
incidents.description: A [Stanford Internet Observatory report](https://purl.stanford.edu/kh752sm9123) found more than 1,000 verified child sexual abuse images in LAION-5B, a public dataset that Stable Diffusion models used for training. [Stability AI said](https://apnews.com/article/generative-ai-illegal-images-child-abuse-3081a81fa79e2a39b67c11201cfd085f) that it trained its models on a filtered part of the dataset. LAION, the nonprofit that manages the dataset, temporarily took its datasets offline.

timeline.title: Stanford researchers start the review
timeline.description: Stanford Internet Observatory researchers begin to examine LAION-5B for CSAM.

timeline.title: Report published
timeline.description: The Stanford Internet Observatory publishes its findings on CSAM in LAION-5B.

timeline.title: Stability AI responds
timeline.description: Stability says its models used a filtered subset of the dataset and that it did not release Stable Diffusion 1.5.

timeline.title: LAION takes datasets offline
timeline.description: LAION says it has a zero-tolerance policy for illegal content and temporarily removes its datasets.
